Public: .average_blanks(save=True) .apply_blanks(save=True, only_within_dates=True, show_comp_plot=False) Private (tested directly for edge cases): ._find_blank_files(multiple_per_day, blank_includes, blank_excludes) ._save_combined_blanks(clean_df, header_info) ._final_check(df_corrected, df_inps) ._extrapolate_blanks(df_blanks, blank_temps, missing_temps, dates, save=True)
Reference: olaf/processing/blank_correction.py Bugs from review covered here: #3 qc_flag = int (class, not 0) (blank_correction.py:393) #4 Pathological chained comparison (blank_correction.py:402-410) #5 prev_temp -= 1 on float temp label (blank_correction.py:411) """

Real data: tests/test_data/test_project/SGP 5.15.24 6.20.24 blanks/ """ pytest.skip("not implemented")

Real data: tests/test_data/capek/ """ pytest.skip("not implemented")

Real data: tests/test_data/capek/KCG 05.21.24 07.19.24 blank/ + tests/test_data/capek/KCG 07.10.24 08.06.24 blank/ Reference: existing combined_blank_2024-05-21_2024-08-06.csv in repo. """ pytest.skip("not implemented")

Source: blank_correction.py average_blanks zero/negative filter. """ pytest.skip("not implemented")

When: apply_blanks(save=False, only_within_dates=True) Then: for the 'KCG 7.09.24 base' sample, blank-corrected output equals goldens/test_blank_correction/capek_kcg_7_09_24_base_corrected.csv
Real data: tests/test_data/capek/KCG 7.09.24 base/ """ pytest.skip("not implemented")

Source: blank_correction.py apply_blanks date-window filter. """ pytest.skip("not implemented")

Source: blank_correction.py:393 """ # TODO: build synthetic df_corrected & df_inps via synthetic_inps_csv_factory # TODO: call _final_check and assert dtype == object (pins bug) pytest.skip("not implemented — pins bug #3 current behavior")

Source: blank_correction.py:402-410 """ pytest.skip("not implemented — pins bug #4 current behavior")

option.value: """ Tests for olaf.processing.blank_correction Class under test: BlankCorrector(project_folder, ...) Public: .average_blanks(save=True) .apply_blanks(save=True, only_within_dates=True, show_comp_plot=False) Private (tested directly for edge cases): ._find_blank_files(multiple_per_day, blank_includes, blank_excludes) ._final_check(df_corrected, df_inps) ._extrapolate_blanks(df_blanks, blank_temps, missing_temps, dates, save=True) Reference: olaf/processing/blank_correction.py Bugs from review covered here: #3 qc_flag = int (class, not 0) (blank_correction.py:393) #4 Chained comparison (smell, may be benign) (blank_correction.py:402-410) #5 prev_temp -= 1 walk-back (blank_correction.py:411) """ from __future__ import annotations import shutil from pathlib import Path import pandas as pd import pytest from olaf.CONSTANTS import ERROR_SIGNAL from olaf.processing.blank_correction import BlankCorrector # --------------------------------------------------------------------------- # Helpers # --------------------------------------------------------------------------- def _empty_corrector(project_folder: Path) -> BlankCorrector: """BlankCorrector instance with no real blank files; used for unit-testing private methods that don't need pre-loaded blanks.""" return BlankCorrector( project_folder=project_folder, blank_includes=("__nothing__",), blank_excludes=(), sample_excludes=(), ) def _capek_curated(capek_golden_folder: Path) -> bool: """True iff a capek golden subset exists with >= 1 blank folder containing an INPs_L_*.csv.""" if not capek_golden_folder.exists(): return False for sub in capek_golden_folder.iterdir(): if sub.is_dir() and "blank" in sub.name.lower(): if any(p.name.startswith("INPs_L") for p in sub.iterdir() if p.is_file()): return True return False # --------------------------------------------------------------------------- # TestFindBlankFiles # --------------------------------------------------------------------------- class TestFindBlankFiles: """Locating blank folders and the latest INPs_L_*.csv within each.""" def test_finds_blank_folders(self, capek_golden_folder: Path) -> None: """ Given: curated capek goldens with at least one '* blank' subfolder. When: BlankCorrector._find_blank_files runs via __init__. Then: returns a non-empty list of paths; every path exists; every filename contains 'INPs_L'. Real data: curate from `tests/test_data/capek/` per `tests/test_data/goldens/inputs/capek/.NEEDED.md`. """ if not _capek_curated(capek_golden_folder): pytest.skip("capek goldens not curated (see goldens/inputs/capek/.NEEDED.md)") bc = BlankCorrector( project_folder=capek_golden_folder, blank_includes=("INPs_L",), blank_excludes=("blank_corrected",), sample_excludes=(), ) assert bc.blank_files, "no blank files discovered" for p in bc.blank_files: assert p.exists(), p assert "INPs_L" in p.name, p.name def test_finds_files_from_each_blank_subfolder(self, capek_golden_folder: Path) -> None: """Two distinct blank folders => files from both are returned.""" if not _capek_curated(capek_golden_folder): pytest.skip("capek goldens not curated") blank_subfolders = [ d for d in capek_golden_folder.iterdir() if d.is_dir() and "blank" in d.name.lower() ] if len(blank_subfolders) < 2: pytest.skip("need >= 2 blank subfolders in capek goldens for this test") bc = BlankCorrector( project_folder=capek_golden_folder, blank_includes=("INPs_L",), blank_excludes=("blank_corrected",), sample_excludes=(), ) parents = {p.parent.name for p in bc.blank_files} assert len(parents) >= 2, f"blank files only from {parents}" def test_multiple_per_day_flag(self, synthetic_blank_folder) -> None: """multiple_per_day=True returns >= as many files as multiple_per_day=False. Uses synthetic project tree to avoid depending on capek golden curation. """ project = synthetic_blank_folder(num_blanks=2, num_samples=0) # Duplicate every blank with a (1) suffix to simulate multi-version-per-day for blank_dir in project.iterdir(): if "blank" not in blank_dir.name: continue for csv in list(blank_dir.glob("INPs_L_*.csv")): dup = csv.with_name(csv.stem + "(1)" + csv.suffix) dup.write_bytes(csv.read_bytes()) bc_single = BlankCorrector( project_folder=project, blank_includes=("INPs_L",), blank_excludes=("blank_corrected",), sample_excludes=(), multiple_per_day=False, ) bc_multi = BlankCorrector( project_folder=project, blank_includes=("INPs_L",), blank_excludes=("blank_corrected",), sample_excludes=(), multiple_per_day=True, ) assert len(bc_multi.blank_files) >= len(bc_single.blank_files) # --------------------------------------------------------------------------- # TestAverageBlanks # --------------------------------------------------------------------------- class TestAverageBlanks: """Combining multiple blank INPs_L files into one combined_blank_*.csv.""" def test_capek_combined_blank_golden( self, capek_golden_folder: Path, goldens_root: Path, assert_csv_matches_golden, ) -> None: """ Given: curated capek goldens with >= 1 blank folder. When: BlankCorrector.average_blanks(save=False) Then: result equals goldens/expected/test_blank_correction/capek_combined_blank.csv Regenerate with `OLAF_REGEN_GOLDEN=1 pytest <this test>`. """ if not _capek_curated(capek_golden_folder): pytest.skip("capek goldens not curated") bc = BlankCorrector( project_folder=capek_golden_folder, blank_includes=("INPs_L",), blank_excludes=("blank_corrected",), sample_excludes=(), ) result = bc.average_blanks(save=False) actual = result.reset_index() # degC -> column for stable CSV roundtrip assert_csv_matches_golden( actual, goldens_root / "expected" / "test_blank_correction" / "capek_combined_blank.csv", ) def test_zero_and_negative_inps_filtered_out(self, synthetic_blank_folder) -> None: """Rows with INPS_L <= 0 are excluded from the average (line 79).""" df_with_zeros = pd.DataFrame( { "degC": [-18.0, -19.0, -20.0, -21.0], "dilution": [1, 1, 1, 1], "INPS_L": [0.0, -5.0, 10.0, 20.0], "lower_CI": [0.0, 0.0, 5.0, 10.0], "upper_CI": [0.0, 0.0, 15.0, 30.0], } ) project = synthetic_blank_folder( num_blanks=1, num_samples=0, blank_inps_df=df_with_zeros ) bc = BlankCorrector( project_folder=project, blank_includes=("INPs_L",), blank_excludes=("blank_corrected",), sample_excludes=(), ) result = bc.average_blanks(save=False) assert -18.0 not in result.index assert -19.0 not in result.index assert -20.0 in result.index assert -21.0 in result.index def test_header_info_merged_across_files(self, synthetic_blank_folder) -> None: """Combined header: start_time = earliest, end_time = latest.""" df = pd.DataFrame( { "degC": [-20.0, -21.0], "dilution": [1, 1], "INPS_L": [10.0, 20.0], "lower_CI": [5.0, 10.0], "upper_CI": [15.0, 30.0], } ) # synthetic_blank_folder uses month = 5 + i for blank #i project = synthetic_blank_folder(num_blanks=2, num_samples=0, blank_inps_df=df) bc = BlankCorrector( project_folder=project, blank_includes=("INPs_L",), blank_excludes=("blank_corrected",), sample_excludes=(), ) bc.average_blanks(save=False) (key,) = list(bc.combined_blank.keys()) start, end = key assert start.month == 5 assert end.month == 6 # --------------------------------------------------------------------------- # TestApplyBlanks # --------------------------------------------------------------------------- class TestApplyBlanks: """Subtracting combined blanks from sample INPs/L with error propagation.""" def test_capek_blank_corrected_golden( self, capek_golden_folder: Path, goldens_root: Path, assert_csv_matches_golden, tmp_path: Path, ) -> None: """ Given: curated capek goldens with combined_blank produced & >= 1 sample folder. When: apply_blanks(save=True, only_within_dates=False) on a tmp copy. Then: first blank_corrected_*.csv emitted equals its golden. Regenerate via `OLAF_REGEN_GOLDEN=1 pytest <this test>`. """ if not _capek_curated(capek_golden_folder): pytest.skip("capek goldens not curated") work = tmp_path / "capek" shutil.copytree(capek_golden_folder, work) bc = BlankCorrector( project_folder=work, blank_includes=("INPs_L",), blank_excludes=("blank_corrected",), sample_excludes=(), ) bc.average_blanks(save=False) bc.apply_blanks(save=True, only_within_dates=False, show_comp_plot=False) produced = sorted(work.rglob("blank_corrected_*.csv")) if not produced: pytest.skip("no sample folders curated for apply_blanks (see .NEEDED.md)") from olaf.utils.df_utils import read_with_flexible_header _, actual_df = read_with_flexible_header(produced[0]) assert_csv_matches_golden( actual_df, goldens_root / "expected" / "test_blank_correction" / f"{produced[0].stem}.csv", ) def test_only_within_dates_filters_out_of_range_samples(self, synthetic_blank_folder) -> None: """only_within_dates=True skips samples outside any blank's coverage window.""" df = pd.DataFrame( { "degC": [-20.0, -21.0, -22.0], "dilution": [1, 1, 1], "INPS_L": [10.0, 20.0, 40.0], "lower_CI": [5.0, 10.0, 20.0], "upper_CI": [15.0, 30.0, 60.0], } ) project = synthetic_blank_folder( num_blanks=1, num_samples=1, blank_inps_df=df, sample_inps_df=df, sample_header_overrides=[ { "start_time": "2024-09-10 00:00:00", "end_time": "2024-09-10 12:00:00", } ], ) # Rename the sample folder so its name reflects the September date # (is_within_dates parses the folder name). for sub in project.iterdir(): if "blank" not in sub.name and sub.is_dir(): sub.rename(sub.parent / "TEST 09.10.24 base") break bc = BlankCorrector( project_folder=project, blank_includes=("INPs_L",), blank_excludes=("blank_corrected",), sample_excludes=(), ) bc.average_blanks(save=False) bc.apply_blanks(save=True, only_within_dates=True) produced = list(project.rglob("blank_corrected_*.csv")) assert produced == [], f"sample outside date window still processed: {produced}" def test_only_within_dates_false_processes_all(self, synthetic_blank_folder) -> None: """only_within_dates=False processes the September sample anyway.""" df = pd.DataFrame( { "degC": [-20.0, -21.0, -22.0], "dilution": [1, 1, 1], "INPS_L": [10.0, 20.0, 40.0], "lower_CI": [5.0, 10.0, 20.0], "upper_CI": [15.0, 30.0, 60.0], } ) project = synthetic_blank_folder( num_blanks=1, num_samples=1, blank_inps_df=df, sample_inps_df=df, sample_header_overrides=[ { "start_time": "2024-09-10 00:00:00", "end_time": "2024-09-10 12:00:00", } ], ) for sub in project.iterdir(): if "blank" not in sub.name and sub.is_dir(): sub.rename(sub.parent / "TEST 09.10.24 base") break bc = BlankCorrector( project_folder=project, blank_includes=("INPs_L",), blank_excludes=("blank_corrected",), sample_excludes=(), ) bc.average_blanks(save=False) bc.apply_blanks(save=True, only_within_dates=False) produced = list(project.rglob("blank_corrected_*.csv")) assert len(produced) == 1, f"expected 1 corrected file, got {produced}" # --------------------------------------------------------------------------- # TestFinalCheck — synthetic, pins current (possibly buggy) behavior # --------------------------------------------------------------------------- def _final_check_inputs( inps_l: list[float], lower_ci: list[float] | None = None, upper_ci: list[float] | None = None, corrected: list[float] | None = None, ) -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, pd.DataFrame]: """Build (df_corrected, df_inps) inputs for `_final_check`. Both share a default RangeIndex, matching the real call site (degC has been reset to a column before _final_check is invoked). """ n = len(inps_l) lower = lower_ci if lower_ci is not None else [v * 0.5 for v in inps_l] upper = upper_ci if upper_ci is not None else [v * 1.5 for v in inps_l] corr = corrected if corrected is not None else list(inps_l) degc = [-20.0 - 0.5 * i for i in range(n)] df_inps = pd.DataFrame( {"degC": degc, "INPS_L": inps_l, "lower_CI": lower, "upper_CI": upper} ) df_corrected = pd.DataFrame( {"degC": degc, "INPS_L": corr, "lower_CI": lower, "upper_CI": upper} ) return df_corrected, df_inps class TestFinalCheck: """Post-correction QC: monotonicity, error-signal substitution, qc_flag column.""" def test_qc_flag_column_dtype_pins_current_behavior(self, tmp_path: Path) -> None: """ BUG #3 anchor. Current code: `df_corrected["qc_flag"] = int` assigns the Python `int` TYPE to every row, making the column dtype 'object'. The subsequent loop overwrites every row to 0 or 1, but pandas does not downcast in-place, so dtype stays 'object'. Fix: should be int64 default 0. Source: blank_correction.py:393 """ bc = _empty_corrector(tmp_path) df_corrected, df_inps = _final_check_inputs([10.0, 20.0, 40.0, 80.0, 160.0]) result = bc._final_check(df_corrected, df_inps) assert result["qc_flag"].dtype == object, ( f"qc_flag dtype expected object (current bug); got {result['qc_flag'].dtype}" ) assert set(result["qc_flag"].unique()).issubset({0, 1}), ( f"qc_flag values should be 0/1 post-loop; got {result['qc_flag'].unique()}" ) def test_monotonic_input_yields_all_zero_qc(self, tmp_path: Path) -> None: """Strictly monotonic INPS_L (increasing as degC decreases) => qc_flag all 0.""" bc = _empty_corrector(tmp_path) df_corrected, df_inps = _final_check_inputs([10.0, 20.0, 40.0, 80.0, 160.0]) result = bc._final_check(df_corrected, df_inps) assert (result["qc_flag"] == 0).all(), result["qc_flag"].tolist() def test_non_monotonic_corrected_inps_triggers_replacement(self, tmp_path: Path) -> None: """ BUG #4 anchor. Given: df_corrected has a non-monotonic dip (row[2] < row[1]); df_inps matches (so the below-CI branch does NOT replace with ERROR_SIGNAL). Then: the monotonicity branch fires, replacing row[2] with row[1]'s INPS_L and setting qc_flag=1. Source: blank_correction.py:402-410 """ bc = _empty_corrector(tmp_path) df_corrected, df_inps = _final_check_inputs( inps_l=[10.0, 50.0, 30.0, 80.0, 160.0], corrected=[10.0, 50.0, 30.0, 80.0, 160.0], ) result = bc._final_check(df_corrected, df_inps) assert result.iloc[2]["INPS_L"] == 50.0, result.iloc[2].to_dict() assert result.iloc[2]["qc_flag"] == 1 def test_prev_temp_decrement_with_error_signal_pins_behavior(self, tmp_path: Path) -> None: """ BUG #5 anchor. Given: corrected[row 2] == ERROR_SIGNAL; corrected[row 3] < corrected[row 1]. When: _final_check runs. Then: the chained comparison `current < prev != ES != current` becomes `30 < -9999 and -9999 != -9999 and -9999 != 30` => False. The non-monotonic branch does NOT fire on row 3 — it keeps 30.0 and qc_flag=0. We pin: the `prev_temp -= 1` walk-back is dead code in practice. Source: blank_correction.py:411 """ bc = _empty_corrector(tmp_path) df_corrected, df_inps = _final_check_inputs( inps_l=[10.0, 50.0, 50.0, 30.0, 160.0], corrected=[10.0, 50.0, ERROR_SIGNAL, 30.0, 160.0], ) result = bc._final_check(df_corrected, df_inps) assert result.iloc[2]["INPS_L"] == ERROR_SIGNAL assert result.iloc[3]["INPS_L"] == 30.0 assert result.iloc[3]["qc_flag"] == 0 # --------------------------------------------------------------------------- # TestExtrapolateBlanks — synthetic # --------------------------------------------------------------------------- def _blank_df( temps: list[float], inps: list[float], lower: list[float] | None = None, upper: list[float] | None = None, ) -> pd.DataFrame: """Build a df_blanks DataFrame indexed by degC (descending).""" n = len(temps) df = pd.DataFrame( { # Use tuple cells (object dtype) to match real combined_blank format — # otherwise _extrapolate_blanks raises "setting an array element with # a sequence" when injecting an extrapolated row whose dilution is a # tuple from unique_dilutions(). "dilution": pd.Series([(1,)] * n, dtype=object), "INPS_L": inps, "lower_CI": lower if lower is not None else [v * 0.5 for v in inps], "upper_CI": upper if upper is not None else [v * 1.5 for v in inps], "blank_count": [1] * n, }, index=pd.Index(temps, name="degC"), ).sort_index(ascending=False) return df class TestExtrapolateBlanks: """Linear extrapolation when sample covers colder temps than blanks.""" def test_below_range_linear_extrapolation(self, tmp_path: Path) -> None: """Adds rows below min(blank_temps) using linear fit of last 4 points.""" bc = _empty_corrector(tmp_path) df_blanks = _blank_df( temps=[-20.0, -21.0, -22.0, -23.0], inps=[10.0, 20.0, 40.0, 80.0], ) blank_temps = df_blanks.index.to_series() missing = {-24.0, -25.0} dates = (pd.Timestamp("2024-05-01"), pd.Timestamp("2024-05-15")) out_df, _out_temps = bc._extrapolate_blanks( df_blanks, blank_temps, missing, dates, save=False ) assert -24.0 in out_df.index assert -25.0 in out_df.index assert list(out_df.index) == sorted(out_df.index, reverse=True) # blank_count of extrapolated rows is 0 (marker) assert out_df.loc[-24.0, "blank_count"] == 0 assert out_df.loc[-25.0, "blank_count"] == 0 def test_non_monotonic_last_point_excluded_from_fit(self, tmp_path: Path) -> None: """If the coldest blank breaks monotonicity it is excluded from the fit AND added to the extrapolation set so it gets recomputed.""" bc = _empty_corrector(tmp_path) df_blanks = _blank_df( temps=[-20.0, -21.0, -22.0, -23.0], inps=[10.0, 20.0, 40.0, 5.0], # -23 drops below -22 ) blank_temps = df_blanks.index.to_series() dates = (pd.Timestamp("2024-05-01"), pd.Timestamp("2024-05-15")) out_df, _ = bc._extrapolate_blanks( df_blanks, blank_temps, {-24.0}, dates, save=False ) assert -24.0 in out_df.index # -23 was non-monotonic AND added back to extrapolation_temps;
